_note: Next.js sites (taste-of-dekalb was the first): the mirror is the RENDERED DOM snapshot, and the Next hydration runtime must be stripped — left in place it re-renders client-side and constructs /_next/image optimizer URLs at runtime (dynamic endpoint, 404s offline; killed the A6 gate with variants the mirror never saw). Killing /_next/static/ scripts + __next_f inline chunks freezes the snapshot; CSS <link>s under /_next/static are untouched (killlist only strips <script>s). Interactivity is lost by design — same trade as neutralized Shopify carts.
